messages.author: 81ef2b0501f804f5
messages.subject: Problem with disabling  on-disk bookmarking
parts:
I am working on the data science capstone project shiny app[.  The model works well under Rstudio.  But every time I run it on shinyapps.io I get the following error
 "Shiny cannot use on-disk bookmarking". Reading the forums I found a solution to disable bookmarking.
 shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server, enableBookmarking("disable")).  This did not work, I am still getting the error. 
 Is there any other way of turning off bookmarking?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Problem with disabling  on-disk bookmarking
parts:
You either want to separately call enableBookmarking("disable") before calling shinyApp, or pass enableBookmarking="disable" as a parameter to shinyApp.
You seem to have combined the two.
